mission.name: Maverick daily command
mission.target: reduce active cases to 50 or fewer while keeping every case inside a 14-day handling window
mission.success_signal: lower overdue follow-ups, callbacks, and unresolved open loops before adding new work

daily_cadence.name: Read the field
daily_cadence.exit_condition: top risk lane is chosen before opening new work

daily_cadence.name: Route through canvases
daily_cadence.decision: use Launch Team views as navigation, not as hidden context
daily_cadence.exit_condition: each action points to a specific canvas or local evidence file

daily_cadence.name: Dispatch guarded bot actions
daily_cadence.decision: quick replies can plan, draft, search, or classify; external effects stay gated
daily_cadence.exit_condition: no write/send/update occurs without a matching confirmation token

daily_cadence.name: Close the loop
daily_cadence.decision: record only memory that changes the next decision
daily_cadence.exit_condition: case state, blocker, next action, and due window are explicit

today_objectives.action: work overdue and day-10-to-13 cases before low-risk new tasks
batch callbacks through the Callback canvas and capture next follow-up
confirm QA or final blocker before marking work closed
pull reactivation candidates into active case review without copying stale rows wholesale

canvas_routes.name: Follow-ups
canvas_routes.use_when: due today, overdue, and one-week follow-up sweep

canvas_routes.name: Callback
canvas_routes.use_when: call block planning and callback recovery

canvas_routes.name: QA Breakdown
canvas_routes.use_when: same-day QA, resolved-but-open, and close-readiness checks

canvas_routes.name: Observation Bin
canvas_routes.use_when: aging cases that need a stronger decision

canvas_routes.name: Archive Ready
canvas_routes.use_when: final close, park, or escalation decision

bot_dispatch.name: Argo / Buddy dispatch
bot_dispatch.guardrail: Bot token must live in a secret store, never in Notion or transcripts.
bot_dispatch.external_effects: Notion updates, Slack app messages, Gmail sends, Calendar mutations, GitHub publish, and iCloud export require confirmation gates.

capture: resolution pattern that applies to future cases
learning_loop.promotion_rule: promote a note only when it changes routing, priority, or the next useful action.

confirmation_gates.next_confirmation: repo owner/name or confirmation to create a new repo; branch name
local mounted folder path or authenticated upload route; confirmation that Maverick artifacts should be copied there
live row query method; write/update method
Slack channel or DM target where Maverick should communicate with Edwin; bot token stored only in a secret store
